_comment: Lane A - locked keyframe generation. Illustrious XL v2.0 (CreativeML Open RAIL-M - commercial use of model + outputs permitted, Attachment A restrictions; see research/weights-and-licences.md) + per-character SDXL LoRA (node 2, trained by kaggle/sdxl-lora-train) + IP-Adapter PLUS (CLIP ViT-H variant - NOT FaceID; node 7 preset 'PLUS (high strength)', node 8 IPAdapterAdvanced, signatures verified in the cloned ComfyUI_IPAdapter_plus source) + ControlNet: AnimeLineArtPreprocessor (comfyui_controlnet_aux) extracting lineart from the drawn cue/pose source, applied through the xinsir Canny SDXL ControlNet (an edge-map model - lineart IS an edge map; this pairing is deliberate and documented in the WIRING-REPORT). Pose variant: swap node 4 to DWPreprocessor and node 5 to controlnet-openpose-sdxl.safetensors. Placeholders the kernel/runner fills per job: node 2 lora_name, node 9 text (trigger + pose caption), node 3 control source, node 6 canon anchor.
